[C] FloatingBox variants
+-- DisplayNodeBase: pixel geometry + childIds
|   +-- position / bounds / canvas-or-viewport space
|   +-- expansion / expandedGeometry
|   `-- geometryPolicy: automatic/manual; content/fixed
+-- FloatingPane: persisted in DisplayState.nodes
|   +-- SelectionRegion
|   |   +-- source box/content/ASCII/revision; rect; IDs
|   |   `-- SelectionState owns membership; pane captures
|   +-- ProjectedPane: title / revision IDs / active child
|   |   +-- call-tree(result, coverage) / compaction(files)
|   |   `-- source-code(files, file) / code-panel(panel)
|   +-- ConversationPane: thread / draft / presentation
|   |   `-- canvasAnchor: semantic bubble attachment
|   `-- DetailPane: title / ascii / sectionId?
+-- FloatingBoxArrow: derived from document.edges
|   `-- scene + views + cell + endpoint bounds -> drawEdge
+-- DisplayState: rootIds + pane hierarchy
|   +-- addDisplayNode -> attach root or owner's child
|   +-- removeDisplayNode -> remove subtree; repair links
|   `-- setExpansion -> retain/restore expanded allocation
+-- Geometry updates: updateDisplayGeometry shared path
|   `-- measureDisplayNode respects fixed expanded sizing
+-- canvasDisplayNodes derives placement
|   +-- automatic selection/projection -> region/parent
|   `-- conversation -> anchor/presentation; else stored
`-- SourcePaneViewState owns live source scroll
    `-- captureDisplay samples it into saved pane content
